title: Global Medic 2013 Pick-up Whiffle-ball Game and C-130 Landing and Takeoff
description: U.S. Air Force Airmen, 944th Civil Engineering Squadron, Luke Air Force Base, Ariz., 932d Civil Engineering Squadron, Scott Air Force Base, Ill. and 910th Civil Engineering Squadron, Youngstown Air Reserve Base, Ohio participate in an intermural pick-up whiffle-ball game after duty hours as a U.S. Air Force C-130 from the 152d Airlift Wing, Nevada Air National Guard Base, Reno takes-off during Exercise Global Medic 2013, Ft. McCoy, Wis., July 17, 2013. Global Medic is an annual joint-reserve field-training exercise designed to replicate all facets of combat theater aeromedical evacuation support. (U.S. Air Force Video by SrA Garrett Wake, 4 CTCS/RELEASED) Available in High Definition.
keywords: Scott AFB, Global Medic, Garrett Wake, 152nd Airlift, Reno ANG, 944th CES, 932nd CES, 910th CES, Youngstown ARB, Luke AFB
